-  Fully Remote
-  32 Hours/Week Preferred


About ZOVU

Restaurants have enough to worry about. Their software shouldn't be one of those things.

At ZOVU, we're building the Operating System for the modern restaurant. Our vision is simple: one connected platform bringing together Point of Sale, reservations, loyalty, staff operations, and the customer experience.

And we're doing things differently.

Instead of charging restaurants expensive monthly subscriptions, our business model is built around transactions. When restaurants grow, we grow with them.

We're an early-stage, fully remote startup preparing for our first restaurant launches. There's already a product in development, a team building it, and plenty of ambitious work ahead.

If you enjoy creating things that people will actually use, you'll feel at home here.

The Role

We're looking for an ambitious Backend Developer Intern to help build the systems behind ZOVU.

This isn't an internship where you'll spend three months watching someone else code.

You'll contribute to real software, develop new functionality, investigate problems, and work alongside our engineering team to bring ZOVU closer to launch.

Your work will help power the technology restaurant owners, staff, and customers interact with every day.

We're not looking for someone who knows every framework. We're looking for someone who knows how to build.

What Excites You



- Building Something from the Ground Up: You enjoy turning ideas into working software and watching a product come together.
- Solving Real Problems: You like figuring out why something doesn't work and finding a better way to build it.
- Taking Ownership: You're excited to take responsibility for your own work rather than wait for instructions at every step.
- Learning Through Experience: You want to grow by contributing to real projects alongside other developers.
- Startup Life: You enjoy an environment where ideas matter, priorities evolve, and your contributions make a difference.


What Excites Us



- Experience That Shows: You've already built backend functionality through internships, freelance work, professional experience, or substantial personal projects.
- Backend Fundamentals: You're comfortable with server-side JavaScript or TypeScript, APIs, and relational databases.
- Practical Problem-Solving: You've encountered technical problems, investigated them, and worked toward reliable solutions.
- Real Ownership: You can clearly explain what you personally built, rather than only describing what your team accomplished.
- Development Practices: You've worked with Git and understand the importance of readable, maintainable code.
- Independence: You can make progress on assigned work, communicate blockers, and ask useful questions when needed.
- Communication: You're comfortable collaborating in English with a remote, international team.


Bonus points: Experience contributing to production software, business applications, or products used by real customers.

We care more about what you've actually built than a long list of technologies on your CV.

Internship Details & Growth

This is a hands-on internship where you'll develop your backend engineering skills through practical work, technical guidance, and collaboration with our engineering team.



- Duration: Three months.
- Location: 100% remote.
- Availability: Approximately 32 hours per week preferred.
- Start Date: As soon as possible. You must be able to start within three months of applying.


The Good Stuff!



- Real Product Experience: Contribute to an actual software platform preparing for its first restaurant launches.
- Meaningful Responsibilities: Work on features that matter, not just practice assignments.
- Direct Access to the Team: Collaborate with developers and receive feedback on your work.
- Room to Grow: Strengthen your skills by facing real development challenges.
- Your Work Matters: Join at an early stage where individual contributions can have a visible impact.


Life at ZOVU

We're a remote team connected by one ambition: making restaurant operations simpler through better technology.

We value people who take initiative, communicate openly, care about their work, and enjoy solving problems together.

You don't need to have every answer. But you should be curious enough to find them.

We're building something ambitious, and we'd love to have people on board who are excited to help make it happen.

Ready to Build With Us?

We'd love to see what you can bring to ZOVU.

Apply through the job posting with your CV or send a mail to Hr@zovuhq.com and the following information:

1. Show us what you've built.

Share one or two backend projects or features you personally developed. Explain your specific contribution and include a GitHub repository, pull request, or project link where available. If your work is private, describe it without sharing confidential information.

2. Tell us about a real challenge.

Describe one technical problem you've personally encountered while building software, what you did to resolve it, and what you learned.

3. Your availability.

Include your earliest start date, hours available per week.

We value concrete examples, genuine experience, and your own words over polished applications.

Let's build something restaurants will depend on.

About GlobalFoundries

GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, powerefficient and highperformance solutions for highgrowth markets. GF is a trusted and holistic technology partner for customers around the world. GF’s talented, global team remains focused every day on security, longevity, and sustainability. For more information, visit www.gf.com.

Internship Program Overview

Our Interns & Co-ops are our entry-level talent pipeline for GF across the globe. Our goal is to provide students with a meaningful work experience that will equip them with the skills to embark on a career in the fast-paced and growing semiconductor industry after graduation. As an intern at GF, you’ll experience one-on-one mentorship, work assignments that prioritize your growth and potential, professional development opportunities, and the chance to network with executives.

Summary Of Role

GlobalFoundries is seeking a curious and driven AI Software Intern to help bridge cutting-edge machine learning research and scalable software production. Working alongside senior software engineers, the intern will build, optimize, test, and deploy AI models within an AI platform while gaining hands-on exposure to the AI inference software lifecycle and AI processor architectures.

Essential Responsibilities Include



- Assist with integrating, deploying, testing, and scaling machine learning models, including large language, computer vision, and predictive models, within production-oriented AI pipelines. 
- Analyze latency, memory usage, and computational footprint, and help optimize AI inference workflows for edge devices or cloud infrastructure. 
- Use modern AI-assisted development tools to accelerate software prototyping, code development, testing, and debugging while following team engineering and review practices. 
- Document engineering designs, experiment configurations, performance benchmarks, software interfaces, and API architectures so work is clear, reproducible, and maintainable. 

Other Responsibilities



- Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements and programs. 

Required Qualifications



- Education – At least a sophomore at time of application and actively pursuing a Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science or related field through an accredited degree program during the time of internship. 
- Must have at least an overall 3.0 GPA and be in good academic standing. 
- Familiarity with at least one major machine learning framework, such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. 
- Strong understanding of object-oriented programming and software version control using GitLab, GitHub, or related tools. 
- Ability to navigate ambiguous technical problems, learn new tools quickly, and communicate technical trade-offs effectively. 
- Language Fluency - English (Written & Verbal) 
- Ability to work at least 40 hours per week during the internship. 

Preferred Qualifications



- Prior related internship or co-op experience 
- Demonstrated prior leadership experience in the workplace, school projects, competitions, etc. 
- Strong interest in leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance productivity, streamline workflows, and support effective decision-making. 
- Project management skills, i.e., the ability to innovate and execute on solutions that matter; the ability to navigate ambiguity. 
- Strong written and verbal communication skills 
- Strong planning & organizational skills 
- Familiarity with low-level, high-performance programming, such as kernel optimization, systems programming, or hardware accelerators. 
- Exposure to cloud systems such as AWS, and participation in AI/ML hackathons, open-source projects, or university research labs.

jd:
The Position

Metalenz is developing next-generation sensing systems for consumer electronics with metasurface technology. As an intern on the software team, you will help develop applications that make use of our meta-optic camera systems. You will work with novel polarization imaging systems that require creative approaches to image processing and sensor integration. A successful candidate will be able to design, implement, and deploy software for testing and tuning these systems and for leveraging these systems in customer-facing applications.

What you’ll do

 - Design and implement software that make uses of our unique camera hardware

 - Deploy, test, and optimize these apps on mobile devices

 - Collaborate by writing documentation, engaging in code review, and commenting on design documents

 - Engage with other teams (product, engineering, marketing) to design and deploy software that supports our goals as a company

What you'll need

 - Currently has or in the process of obtaining a BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or relevant field

 - Strong programming skills in C or C++

 - Experience with software engineering best practices (testing, version control, code review)

 - Background in building and deploying applications for embedded systems (through coursework or previous projects)

Preferred Qualifications

 - Familiarity with image processing fundamentals

 - Experience with ARM-based systems and performance optimization (e.g. NEON, DSP)

 - Prior work with Android & related tools (e.g. Android Studio) and mobile development

 - Understanding of camera sensor interfaces and hardware abstraction layers (HAL)

 - Proficiency in Computed Aided Design (CAD) software (e.g. Solidworks)

The Company

Metalenz is driving innovation in optics with metasurface technology, providing image sensing solutions that deliver unprecedented insights to mass market machine vision, enabling advanced sensing and transformative applications to proliferate where compact size & cost-efficient integration is a must for widespread adoption. As the leaders in commercialization, Metalenz innovation has enabled the shift of optics production into the semiconductor foundry, leveraging existing infrastructure and proven manufacturing processes. More than 300 million of the company’s optics have been integrated into consumer devices, replacing conventional lens stacks for compact 3D sensing and resulting in the creation of a rapidly growing metasurface market as use cases rapidly expand.

What We Offer

 - Based in downtown Boston near TD Garden, Metalenz is conveniently located across the street from North Station.

 - Employee Assistance Program

 - Collaborative office space, flexible work schedule with hybrid and/or work-from-home arrangements for qualified positions.

 - Complimentary snacks and drinks, and occasionally lunch on-site.

 - Free gym and bike parking on-site.

 - Fun, energizing, highly collaborative environment in which each team member has the opportunity to make an impact.

Metalenz is an equal-opportunity employer. The Company is committed to providing an open and inclusive environment for all its employees. The Company prohibits discrimination based on race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, geneder identity, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other category protected by law. Applicants who need a reasonable accommodation during the hiring process may contact the hiring team.
